params.body:
Closes #652

On the Transport tab, `SettingsController::updateTransport` wrote the posted text straight to the tariff table (`price`, `marge`, `total`) and to the platform settings. An administrator who typed `138,00`, the way the platform writes amounts everywhere else, got "A non-numeric value encountered" instead of a saved tariff.

## Changes
- The base price per class, the margin, the express percentage and the electric-car surcharge are read through `Custom::parseAmount`, the parser the vehicle sheet already uses: `138,00`, `138.00`, `1.380,00`, `1 380,00` and `1.380` all mean what a reader means.
- A box with nothing numeric in it changes nothing (it used to store an empty string).
- The box keeps showing `138.00`, like every amount box on the platform.
- Rule R P2-8.5 describes the input; finding `transport-tarief-invoer-enkel-punt` marked solved.

## Tests
- `TransportConditionsFollowTheSwitchTest::test_the_administrator_types_a_tariff_with_a_comma_or_a_point`: comma, point, thousands separators, an empty box. On the old controller it fails with the non-numeric error.
- Full suite locally: 3030 tests OK (2 skipped, 1 incomplete). PHPStan: no errors.
params.title: The transport tariffs take an amount with a comma
